test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On 10 Nov 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: In ______ the Mughal emperor appointed the Company as the Diwan of the provinces of Bengal.
solution:
The correct answer is __**1765**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• After the defeat at Plassey, Sirajuddaulah Nawab of Bengal was assassinated and installed the puppet Nawab of Bengal Mir Jafar.
 
• When the company interferes in the internal matter of administration Mir Jafar protested, the Company deposed him and installed Mir Qasim in his place.
 
• When Mir Qasim complained, he in turn was defeated in a battle fought at Buxar (1764), driven out of Bengal, and Mir Jafar was reinstalled.
 
• Nawab had to pay Rs 500,000 every month but the Company wanted more money to finance its wars, and meet the demands of trade and its other expenses.
 
• The Company wanted more territories and more revenue. By the time Mir Jafar died in 1765 the mood of the Company had changed. 
 
• Having failed to work with puppet nawabs, In 1765 the Mughal emperor appointed the Company as the Diwan of the provinces of Bengal.
